text:
emily: FYI we're launching a 6-month pilot for Adoption & Surrogacy Reimbursement + a Paid Leave Extension for primary caregivers. Pilot runs 2025-08-01 through 2026-01-31.

emily: TL;DR: up to $8,000 reimbursement per family for qualified adoption/surrogacy expenses (agency fees, legal, travel). Primary caregivers may request up to 4 additional weeks of paid parental leave (must be taken contiguous with existing parental leave). Full policy + examples here: https://redwoodinference.internal/handbook/people/adoption-surrogacy-pilot

emily: Who's eligible: full-time employees with a qualifying adoption or surrogacy event completed during the pilot window (or finalized after 2024-01-01 for retroactive review). Contractors are not eligible for paid leave extension; see reimbursement rules below.

raj: Quick question 94 I finalized an adoption in Feb 2025 and paid for international travel. Can I apply?

emily: Yes, Raj. If finalization date >= 2024-01-01 you can apply. Submit receipts, the legal finalization document, and a short cover note in the HR portal. Travel receipts (flights, hotels) are eligible when tied to the placement.

nina: Note on international employees: country tax rules vary. For US employees reimbursements are non-wage reimbursements (substantive docs required). Outside US we may process via payroll as taxable reimbursement depending on local law. People Ops will surface country-specific guidance on the handbook page.

carlos: Finance details: expense code for reimbursements is `ADP-REIM`; payroll code for the leave extension is `PAR-EXT`. Reimbursements are paid as a separate payroll reimbursement line and typically post within 2 payroll cycles after approval. For surrogacy agency invoices please include invoice number and vendor name.

sam: Are surrogacy agency direct-payments supported (we pay agency directly)?

emily: We support both reimbursements and direct vendor payments. For direct payments, submit vendor W-9 equivalent and invoice to people-ops-finance@redwood.com and copy your People Ops rep. Direct payments only for registered agencies and after finance approval.

raj: Any cap on family-level reimbursements or multiple events in the pilot?

emily: Cap is $8,000 per family per adoption/surrogacy event. If you have multiple qualifying events (e.g., separate adoptions) each can be reviewed separately, but total company-funded exposure is capped for the pilot window.

nina: Please also note documentation checklist required for approval: 1) finalization decree/placement letter, 2) agency invoice or legal bill, 3) receipts for travel if claimed. Missing docs will delay processing.

carlos: Finance tip: attach receipts as PDFs named `LASTNAME_ADP_YYYYMMDD.pdf` to speed routing.

emily: Contractors: reimbursement eligibility for contractors is limited to expense-only reimbursement (no paid leave). If you're a contractor, talk to your manager and People Ops before submitting.

policy-bot: Updated policy doc published: /handbook/people/adoption-surrogacy-pilot (v1.0) 94 effective 2025-08-01. Change log: pilot launch, eligibility, reimbursement and leave extension rules.

emily: We'll run a 45-min info session Friday 09:00 PT to walk through examples and the claim workflow. If you can't make it, leave questions here or open a ticket to people-ops-case@redwood.com. Thanks! :sparkles:
